Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification of the right hemithorax with a significant shift of the mediastinum (trachea and heart) to the left, which is characteristic of a massive right pleural effusion exerting mass effect. A tension pneumothorax would present as hyperlucency rather than opacity, and consolidation or atelectasis would typically cause an ipsilateral or neutral shift.
